content.short: StakeMON.ad is a staking portal for delegating MON to Monad validators.
content.description: StakeMON.ad is a staking portal for delegating MON on Monad, with validator selection assisted instead of left to a raw list. The interface covers both mainnet and testnet, and reports rewards per delegation. It is built as a lightweight front end for users who want to stake without operating infrastructure.
content.meta: A delegation front end for MON, where list ordering quietly shapes stake concentration.
